Disney Dreamlight Valley – Pixel Perfect Update – Nintendo Switch 2
Play Disney Dreamlight Valley's Pixel Perfect update now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/disney-dreamlight-valley-nintendo-switch-2-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1064-02&utm_id=P1064-02 

A glitchy arcade machine is causing chaos! Team up with Vanellope to chase down the runaway machine and welcome Ralph to the Valley. 

Amp up the power with the Pop City Star Path! Color your Valley with vibrant street features and neon lights, complete with a bus stop and city tram for your busy new metropolis. Dress to impress with platform sneakers and sparkly makeup—the perfect outfit to inspire a new high score!

Minecraft's Hello Kitty and Friends Furniture add-on is available now on Nintendo Switch! Play today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/minecraft-switch/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Your Minecraft world just got cuter with the Hello Kitty and Friends Furniture add-on! Craft a Vending Machine, collect Gems, and unlock adorable themed furniture. Visit the Marketplace to claim your free Keroppi outfit!

OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II – Release Date Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II release October 1, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order now: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/octopath-traveler-plus-octopath-traveler-ii-bundle-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01 

Get ready to explore Orsterra and Solistia, now with improved framerates and resolution on Nintendo Switch 2! Choose 1 of 8 different travelers, each with different backgrounds and skills. Where will you go? What will you do? Every path is yours to take.  

Pre-order the games individually or together in a bundle!
